note: v508: The invoice form is organized. Customer, number and both dates now sit two-across at the top, so a new invoice is a customer, a line and Save on one screen. Status & payment, customer expenses, mileage and notes are collapsible sections — each header shows what's inside (Paid $300 Check, 2 items $75, 12 miles), and a section that already has something on it opens itself when you edit that invoice. Also fixed: billed customer expenses now show when you reopen an invoice instead of looking empty.
